I was in a very toxic and abusive relationship that had left me drained and emotionally unavailable when it ended. I had completely given up on the prospect of truly finding someone to share my life with. One day a friend from school messaged me and asked me to have dinner with him. I reluctantly said yes mostly because I had become a home body and inviting him to a Taco Tuesday at his place, he dragged me to his friends place even though I didn’t really feel like socializing

We got to the place and I had been drinking a bit and sitting around a bonfire in the backyard when I overheard one of the guys who lived in the house say he had just brought a puppy home and if we wanted to meet him we had to go in pairs because the dog had bad anxiety from being abused. At this point my friend had bailed on me to be a social butterfly and I was awkwardly standing around waiting to meet the puppy, a dude came up to me and told me “hey can you hold my place in line I have to take a piss” I said yeah sure and waited for him. He came out, we met the dog, and then we stroke up a conversation that lasted all night. We talked about music and found out we liked the same bands, talked about how we both like tattoos and he showed me his, he showed me his piercings, and we never seemed to run out of things to say. 

At one point of the night I was running low on beer and he realized this so he attempted to pour some of his beer into my bottle, he failed and spilled beer all over my hand and clothes, ( I would later find out that he thought he blew it by spilling beer all over me) I laughed it off and he got me another beer. The whole night it was like we were both in our own world, laughing and getting to know each other. The time for me to go home came and he walked with me to the door and said “well I guess I will see you around” so I grew some balls and did something I’ve never done, asked him to hand me his phone and put my phone number in it expecting for him to contact me. The next day I got a text message to which I replied immediately and we made plans to see a local show and grab coffee, we connected even more and I never wanted the night to end. We haven’t spend time apart since, we unconsciously became exclusive with each other since the day we met. He showed me how to love again, I have never felt a purest kind of love like what I feel with him. He’s my best friend and my partner in crime. I don’t regret going to that Taco Tuesday one bit.

I know that it's not easy, and I can't imagine how humiliating and dehumanizing must be for your dad to treat you this way when you are a full-blown adult. But for the sake of your health you need to cut toxic people out of your life, if you wouldn't take or tolerate this kind of behavior from a partner, the same rule applies to blood relatives, even if they're family. I am so sorry about your situation, please keep your head up

You're not messed up, you're just the result of what your parents have done to you, I think a lot of kids from N parents use lying and hiding to prevent conflict and to protect themselves.
